title: Transfer codes: what a connector's get or send may say it kept, changed and did not carry, per capability route (E184)
description: The ceiling of a transfer receipt (R-K3): a receipt row's code must be listed here for the receipt's capability route and in the row's own list, and its sentence is the template filled with the row's own measure. A changed code carries the difference the connector's independent check allows (exact; float32: one float32 unit; z-step: half of one of 65,534 steps of the inline's range of values plus one float32 unit, as OpendTect stores a horizon). A route without a row here has no receipt. The capability files are not changed by this document. Version 1.0.0 lists the three horizon routes the J-mvp journey runs.
